NBACK: 1. A face will appear on screen.
2. Does the face match the face that appeared 2 steps earlier?
3. Remember, compare with the face 2 steps earlier, and not the previous face.
4. Tap YES if the faces match, otherwise tap NO.
PARTIALMATCH: 1. A new symbol will appear on the screen. Compare each new symbol to the previous one.
2. Tap YES if both shape AND color match.
3. Tap NO if neither shape NOR color matches.
4. Tap PARTIALLY if ONLY the shape matches.
5. Tap PARTIALLY if ONLY the color matches.
WORDSEARCH: 1. Words will appear at the bottom. Find and mark them on the board.
2. Words can be found horizontally in both ways.
3. Words can be found vertically in both ways.
4. Words can be found diagonally in both ways.
WORDCONNECT: 1. ستظهر مجموعة كلمات بالأسفل. ابحث عنها وظللها.
2. قد تجد الكلمات بشكل أفقي في أي اتجاه.
3. قد تجد الكلمات بشكل رأسي في أي اتجاه.
4. قد تجد الكلمات بشكل قطري في أي اتجاه.
BAGGAGE: 1. Star names will appear. Memorize them well.
2. You will be tested in different mini-games.
3. Tap the star names that appeared earlier.
SAFEPATH: 1. Hazard tiles will appear briefly. Remember them.
2. Two squares will appear on the board.
3. Connect the two squares while avoiding the hazard tiles.
RAINDROPS: 2. Each bubble contains a different equation.
3. Solve each equation quickly before bubbles hit the spikes.
4. The game ends when two bubbles hit the spikes.
BALLARMY: 1. ستظهر أمامك لوحة من الرموز غير مكتملة.
2. ضع القطع الناقصة بحيث لا يتكرر الشكل في أي عمود أو صف.
MISSING: 1. Shapes will appear at the top. Remember them.
2. They will drop through a funnel, and one shape will disappear.
ESTIMATION: 1. Add the numbers on screen. In this example, the result is around 10.
2. Slide your finger to the estimated sum on the number line.
3. The actual result will appear after you submit your answer.
MEMORYMATRIX: 1. Blue tiles will appear briefly. Remember them well.
2. Tap the blue tiles that appeared.
THECUBE: 1. Swipe UP, DOWN, LEFT or RIGHT to match the instructions on the cube.
2. In this example, you should swipe right anywhere on the screen.
3. If you see "NOTHING", just wait and don't swipe.
4. In this example, you should swipe left because red is on the left.
SPINCYCLE: 1. A cycle of shapes will appear. Remember the shape, color, movement, and size.
2. A new cycle will appear. Compare it to the previous cycle.
3. Tap YES or NO to answer each question.
MIGRATION: 1. ستظهر مجموعة من الطائرات الورقية على الشاشة.
2. حرّك إصبعك في الاتجاه الذي تشير إليه الطائرة بالمنتصف.
3. لا تجعل الطائرات الأخرى تشتت تركيزك.
MATCHPAIRS: 1. Tiles with letters and numbers will appear.
2. Tap on tiles with matching pairs.
3. In advanced levels, there will be multiple correct pairs.
PINBALL: 3. إذا اصطمدت الكرة بالحاجز، ستغير اتجاهها بزاوية 90 درجة.
4. اضغط على المكان الذي ستصل إليه الكرة في النهاية.
5. في المراحل المتقدمة ستختفي الحواجز. استخدم ذاكرتك!
SLICER: 1. ستظهر أمامك لوحة من الرموز غير مكتملة.
2. ضع القطع الناقصة بحيث لا يتكرر الشكل في أي عمود أو صف.
LINER: 1. ستظهر أمامك لوحة من الرموز غير مكتملة.
2. ضع القطع الناقصة بحيث لا يتكرر الشكل في أي عمود أو صف.
BREVITY: 1. Tap the unnecessary phrase to make the sentence shorter.
WORDMEMORY: 2. Complete the word by choosing the letters.
CHALKBOARD: 1. Each card will contain a math expression.
2. Tap the card with the greater number.
3. If both cards are equal, tap the EQUAL button.
4. Each 5 correct answers in a row will add 10 seconds.
VISUALDISKS: 2. Choose the top view that matches the side view.
FOURLETTERS: 2. Create a valid word from the shown letters.
SUDOKO: 1. A board with symbol blocks will appear.
2. Drag blocks to fill the board without duplicating symbols in any row or column.
SPEEDMATCH: 1. A shape will appear. Memorize it.
2. Does the shape match the one before it?
3. Tap YES or NO to answer.
TETRISBLOCKS: 1. An empty board will appear on screen.
2. Drag the blocks to fill the board correctly.
PROCESSING: 1. Read the words that appear on screen.
2. Answer questions correctly to gain points.
BRAINSHIFT: 1. A number and an emoji will appear.
2. Decide if the number on the top card is even.
3. Decide if the emoji on the bottom card is smiling.
4. Tap YES or NO to answer each question.
SPEEDPACK: 2. اضغط على مربع أصفر لتضع الجوال فيه و تغلق الحقيبة.
3. يجب أن لا يلمس الجوال أغراض أخرى بعد غلق الحقيبة.
PUZZLEBOX: 1. قم بالضغط على الرقم الذي به أعلى نتيجة من البطاقتين.

PATHREVERSE: 1. A path will appear between the blocks.
2. Connect the blocks in reverse order.
UNIQUE: 3. Examine shape, color, and pattern to find the unique shape.
COLORMATCH: 2. Decide if the meaning of the upper word matches the font color of the bottom word.
3. Tap YES or NO to answer.
FLOW: 1. ستظهر مجموعة من الأسماك الخضراء أو الصفراء.
2. ستتحرك الأسماك في اتجاه رأسي أو أفقي.
3. حرّك إصبعك في الاتجاه الذي "تشير" إليه الأسماك الخضراء.
4. حرّك إصبعك في الاتجاه الذي "تتحرك" فيه الأسماك الصفراء.
MUSTSORT: 1. A group of pets will appear.
2. Tap on the left or right side to sort pets quickly.
DOTS: 1. A board will appear with pairs of dots.
2. Connect each pair of dots to fill the board.
3. You have to fill the entire board without intersecting paths.
CRAZYFEET: 1. Tap on the blue tiles to run.
2. Don't step on the white tiles.
3. Run faster to get additional time!
HEXA: 1. An empty hexa board will appear on screen.
2. Drag the hexa blocks to fill the board correctly.
RULESTILES: 1. A rule will appear on screen. Apply it on the tiles.
2. Memorize each rule. You will be asked to follow previous rules.
WORDPAIRS: 1. A group of words will appear.
2. Tap on synonym pairs (words with similar meaning).
SPATIALSPEEDMATCH: 1. A shape will appear. Memorize it.
2. Does the shape match the one before it?
3. Tap YES or NO to answer.
TRAIL: 1. ستظهر أمامك شخصية في لوحة مربعات.
2. الأسهم ستدلك على الطريق الذي ستأخذه الشخصية.
3. تخيل الطريق في رأسك ثم اضغط على المربع النهائي الذي ستصل إليه الشخصية.

GRAMMAR: 1. Tap the correct word to fill in the blank.
TYPOS: 1. An email will appear on the screen.
2. Tap spelling and grammar mistakes to fix them.
TRICKYWORDS: 1. Tap the correct word to fill in the blank. This game focuses on homophones.
2. Homophones are words with similar pronunciation but different spelling and meaning.
